about: Rideau Lakes is a township in the United Counties of Leeds and Grenville, Ontario, along the Rideau Canal system southwest of Ottawa—not a city. Villages such as Portland, Delta, and Newboro sit among Rideau lakes, locks, and cottage country. About 10,000 people live in Rideau Lakes Township.
